description: This file is a PHP source code defining a class 'Sale' within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension namespace. It contains methods for handling dashboard sale data, including displaying the sale dashboard, saving settings, and retrieving sale statistics.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for the Sale Dashboard extension in OpenCart's admin panel, handling display and settings for sales statistics.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the sale dashboard page, initializing language, titles, breadcrumbs, and view data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the sale dashboard, returning JSON success/error response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves sales data for the dashboard, including total sales, comparison percentage, and sale orders, and returns the view with data.
